create_MutoxClassifier: create a MutoxClassifier instance by passing a torch model to wrap for toxicity classification
run_MutoxClassifier_forward: run the MutoxClassifier forward pass on a torch tensor input to get raw model outputs
run_MutoxClassifier_with_prob: run the MutoxClassifier forward pass with output_prob=True to get sigmoid probabilities
test_MutoxClassifier: test the MutoxClassifier class by passing a tensor and verifying output shape and type
review_MutoxClassifier: review the MutoxClassifier class that wraps a torch model for binary toxicity scoring
